items.answer: Native enthalpy/injected energy spans 0.525–0.559 for C-HI, 0.631–1.108 for C-LO, 0.468–0.498 for G-HI, and 0.615–0.785 for G-LO across retained science ages. The primary convention is H = 2.5∫p dV; 4pV is a literature comparator that multiplies these fractions by 1.6. G-HI ends at 40 Myr; the others extend to 50 Myr.

No, not as a scientific recovery result. The C-HI median of approximately 0.022 was withdrawn because it came from the refuted legacy fixed-1%-area selector. That selector produces cavity-free false positives, increasingly under-recovers larger cavities, and distorts case contrasts. Recovery remains unresolved until a detector passes.

The leading explanation is that zero-gradient outflow boundaries disturb pressure support in the stratified atmosphere, permitting inflow that imports enthalpy and gravitational potential energy. Mass growth and specific-energy comparisons strongly support this mechanism, but causal quantitative closure remains unestablished. The latest handover records all four paired 50-Myr controls completed successfully, while their scientific contrasts remain unevaluated. Numerical bookkeeping closure alone does not establish physical conservation against injection.

Promote stored tr1 to double precision, select cells with tr1 > 1e-3, and give each selected cell full weight; ambient gas is the exact complement. Fractional tracer weighting is not primary. This changes the recovery denominator substantially: binary volumes are 3.8–6.1 times fractional volumes at 10 Myr, and C-LO's historical enthalpy recovery changed from 6.76 to 0.494 through the denominator alone. Tracer cocoons also include nearly ambient material and are not necessarily X-ray-visible cavities.

Exclude G-HI at 50 Myr from every scientific observable and inference. Its lobe/shock reaches the axial boundary: the final margin is only 1.052 kpc and maximum edge pressure is 315.31 times initial pressure. Contamination begins at snapshot 48. Retain these files as archival evidence; selected G-HI science ages end at 40 Myr.

A ratio of 1.08 does not establish detector quality. For the C-HI 5%-deficit rung it accompanies completeness of only 0.36 and purity of 0.70–0.77: geometric errors cancel. Check per-side completeness, purity, missed sides counted as zero, topology/background merges, aperture clipping, viewing dependence, and preservation of four-case contrasts. Keep tracer information diagnostic only; it must not select or repair observed cavities.

No. The May controls use reflective boundaries on a uniform 1-kpc grid; production uses outflow boundaries on a stretched grid. They demonstrate quietness only for their own configurations. For example, the cluster's 50-Myr whole-grid energy change is 4.36e-9 of initial energy and peak Mach is 0.0022, but small regional redistribution remains. Neither those controls nor the new coarse pairs alone establish production-grid stability.

Obtain Barry's explicit authorisation for the new PLUTO simulation before running it. Authorisation of the four coarse paired controls does not extend to another experiment; the production-matched control remains held. First determine whether existing-output post-processing can answer the idea.

The classes are contrast-dependent detection efficiency, especially missed faint low-power cocoons, and segmentation failures, including background merges, off-axis selection and aperture clipping. The planned sequence is a t=0-baseline run to address background/contrast estimation, 120-kpc versus footprint-enclosing aperture sensitivity, a background-merge guard, and scale-aware topology validation. No replacement is accepted; all must be assessed using per-side geometry and factorial contrasts.

Run from the repository root:

uv run python scripts/science/summarise_q032_retained_ladder.py docs/science/assets/q032_retained_method_ladder_2026-10-31/results/method_ladder_rows.csv docs/science/assets/q032_retained_method_ladder_2026-10-31/interpretation --native-root docs/science/assets/q029_binary_native_refresh_2026-09-06/remote_analysis

It needs the retained Q-032 method_ladder_rows.csv and the per-case Q-029 native_energy_selected_age.csv files beneath remote_analysis. These compact inputs regenerate the interpretation summaries without raw HDF5 or map synthesis. Restore missing inputs first.

Yes. For C-HI, projected tracer area inside the 120-kpc aperture falls to 0.92, 0.72 and 0.57 at 30, 40 and 50 Myr. Thus 8%, 28% and 43% respectively lies outside the analysis aperture, limiting every detector's recovery. These are area fractions, not measured enthalpy-loss fractions.

The highest-priority question is whether BND-02 explains the whole-grid excess. The decisive test is the no-jet outflow-minus-reflective contrast: at 50 Myr, predicted mass gains are approximately 4.9e43 g for cluster and 2.4e42 g for group, growing approximately as t² and explained by measured face transport. Agreement within about a factor of two supports the coarse-grid mechanism. Predeclared refutations include mass below 1e43/5e41 g, growth exponent outside 1.6–2.4, or transport explaining less than 90% of mass or hydrodynamic-energy contrast. The controls completed, but these contrasts remain unevaluated; production-specific attribution still requires grid-transfer evidence.
